title: Wilbert Smith document naming von Neumann, Oppenheimer and Vannevar Bush on Roswell reverse-engineering team

tellings.quote: So he found that document, right? like saying or alleging that vonoman and per Oppenheimer I think it was >> and Vanavar Bush >> and Vanar Bush right were on the reverse engineering team for Roswell.

plain: A document connected to Wilbert B. Smith, a Canadian figure, alleges that the mathematician John von Neumann, the physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer and the science administrator Vannevar Bush sat on the team trying to reverse-engineer the craft from Roswell, the reported 1947 crash in New Mexico. An unnamed researcher on the show describes the document second hand, saying "he found that document," and hedges on the names with "I think it was." If true, it would put some of the best-known scientists of the era to work on a recovered craft.
